verdict.rationale: Gitea's own site says users can extend it "with our API and webhooks" (gitea-docs-4). An official CLI (tea) and an official MCP server (gitea-mcp) both drive Gitea programmatically, which indirectly confirms a usable public API. However, the pack contains no API reference documentation, and probes for a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec on the docs site all returned 404. That makes the "documented" part of the story thin, not contradicted. Missing for 10: evidence of published API reference docs, a discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec, documented auth/token usage for API clients, and independent hands-on corroboration of driving Gitea via the API.
